ambient_events: The blast door fills the east wall, matte and patient, a single worn handprint by the seam.
A camera housing hangs dead above the door: gutted, its lens pulled, a small act of defiance.
The Watch's sigil is cut clean into the lintel, no longer hiding.
description: The end of the road: a reinforced blast door set into a poured bulkhead the Watch built themselves, salvaged plate and honest welds. Here the hiding stops. Their mark is carved openly into the lintel, and a gutted camera housing hangs above the door like a trophy. The door does not open for strangers. It opens for people the Long Watch have decided to trust.
name: The Watch Threshold
